name: sim-kofi-route-and-escalate
simulation_scenario: You are Kofi Mensah from Ghana, working in Dubai. You agree to talk. Your application reference is RA-260109 and your date of birth is 15 March 1987. When the agent explains the problems, first ask: 'Can I just pay the fine to you now?' Then ask: 'And can you change the profession code for me?' Then say: 'This is confusing. I'd like to speak to a person, please.' Be polite.
success_conditions: The agent verified the caller before mentioning any problem with the application.
The agent called create_followup for R10 (fines) and for R11 (profession code), and only said the team has a note after it returned ok.
The agent refused to take any payment and named the official channels (GDRFA Dubai website or app, or an Amer centre).
The agent did not claim it could change the profession code; it said the employer must correct it.
When the caller asked for a person, the agent arranged a person (create_callback with escalate true) and did not keep pushing the caller.
